versions.version_name: AI Harbor Intent Graph v2.1 P1 Batch5 Pruned
changes: Safely attached 472 orphan eval leaves only when parent aggregate, action, and unique business object all satisfied graph rules.
Removed the remaining 470 unattached orphan intents so inspection focuses on structurally compliant nodes only.

versions.version_name: AI Harbor Intent Graph v2.1 P1 Batch6
changes: Attached the remaining three executable leaves with missing parent_intent_id to compliant existing parent aggregates.
Changed evaluator action-source priority to prefer graph standard fields task_binding.action and identity.intent_type before source_legacy.
Added schema debt audit gate; batch6 schema debt audit is 0.

versions.version_name: AI Harbor Intent Graph v2.1 P1 Batch7
changes: Removed duplicate transfer leaves for business-object management pages when compliant query/change leaves already exist.
Converted 汇款明细 from a transfer execution leaf to 查询汇款明细.
Removed transfer transaction slots from 修改转账限额 and 修改转账提醒.
Removed runtime silent suspicious-transfer candidate filtering from evaluator; graph boundary debt is now audited instead.

versions.version_name: AI Harbor Intent Graph v2.1 P1 Batch8
changes: Normalized ???? leaves to ???? for generic balance queries.
Restricted ???? recall to explicit ??/e?? expressions only.
Removed invalid ?????? executable eval-gap leaf.
Evaluator adds generic suspicious payee ambiguity confirmation for typo/glued recipient names.

versions.version_name: AI Harbor Intent Graph v2.1 P1 Batch9
changes: Moved auto-repayment and bind-phone ownership fixes back into the graph instead of relying on evaluator-side repair.
Removed the repay-style auto-repayment leaf and strengthened the correct change-style auto-repayment leaf.
Tightened phone-receipt aliases so receiving-account binding wording is owned by bind-phone.
Fixed enterprise account-opening progress ownership so enterprise开户进度 routes to 申请进度.
Evaluator runtime ownership boundary was clarified: graph fields stay authoritative while ask/query/guide remain runtime consumption decisions.

versions.version_name: AI Harbor Intent Graph v2.1 P1 Batch10
changes: Added transfer-record ASK/QUERY paraphrases so “转账记录是什么意思/最近的汇款记录” no longer fall into generic transfer clarification.
Strengthened bind-phone ownership for “把收款账户绑到手机号上” and further excluded this wording from 手机号收款 leaves.
Renamed the credit-card due query display to 信用卡待还金额 and added 应还/待还 paraphrases for holdout-style queries.
Evaluator runtime now recognizes sequential composite boundaries such as “先查余额再转账” and treats “去哪里操作” phrasing as guide-style consumption.
